raw_text:
PLAN "3-Week Powerlifting Peak"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Peak for powerlifting meet in 21 days"

PHASES

  PHASE "Week 1 — Volume Reduction" (1 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 75m "Heavy Squat + Accessory":
        warmup:
          cycling 10m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 5x3 rpe 8 rest 300 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x5 rpe 7 rest 180 seconds
          leg_press 3x8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          leg_curl 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x45 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 5m

      DAY Tuesday training 70m "Heavy Bench + Accessory":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 5x3 rpe 8 rest 300 seconds
          incline_press 3x6 rpe 7 rest 180 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m

      DAY Wednesday rest 0m "Active Recovery":
        warmup:
          walking 20m
        main straight_sets:
          cat_cow 2x10 rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
          bird_dog 2x10 rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
          dead_bug 2x10 rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m

      DAY Thursday training 75m "Heavy Deadlift + Accessory":
        warmup:
          cycling 10m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 5x3 rpe 8 rest 300 seconds
          front_squat 3x3 rpe 6 rest 180 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          back_extension 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          hanging_leg_raise 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m

      DAY Friday training 65m "Bench Variation + Upper Accessory":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x3 rpe 7 rest 240 seconds
          overhead_press 3x5 rpe 7 rest 180 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          seated_row 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5m

      DAY Saturday rest 0m "Full Rest":
        warmup:
          walking 15m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 2x10 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          forward_fold 5m

      DAY Sunday rest 0m "Full Rest":
        warmup:
          walking 15m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 2x10 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          spinal_twist 5m

  PHASE "Week 2 — Intensity Hold, Volume Drop" (1 weeks):
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 65m "Squat Opener Work":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x2 rpe 8..9 rest 300 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 2x4 rpe 6 rest 180 seconds
          leg_curl 2x8 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          plank 2x45 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 5m

      DAY Tuesday training 60m "Bench Opener Work":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x2 rpe 8..9 rest 300 seconds
          dumbbell_row 2x8 rpe 5 rest 120 seconds
          face_pull 2x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 2x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m

      DAY Wednesday rest 0m "Active Recovery":
        warmup:
          walking 20m
        main straight_sets:
          cat_cow 2x10 rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
          bird_dog 2x10 rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m

      DAY Thursday training 65m "Deadlift Opener Work":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 4x2 rpe 8..9 rest 300 seconds
          back_extension 2x10 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 2x10 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          hanging_leg_raise 2x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m

      DAY Friday training 50m "Competition Lift Touch-Up":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 2x1 rpe 7 rest 300 seconds
          bench_press 2x1 rpe 7 rest 300 seconds
          deadlift 2x1 rpe 7 rest 300 seconds
        cooldown:
          forward_fold 5m

      DAY Saturday rest 0m "Full Rest":
        warmup:
          walking 15m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 2x10 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          spinal_twist 5m

      DAY Sunday rest 0m "Full Rest":
        warmup:
          walking 15m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 2x10 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m

  PHASE "Week 3 — Meet Week" (1 weeks):
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Squat and Deadlift Activation":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 2x2 rpe 6 rest 240 seconds
          deadlift 2x1 rpe 6 rest 240 seconds
          glute_bridge 2x8 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 5m

      DAY Tuesday training 35m "Bench Activation":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 2x2 rpe 6 rest 240 seconds
          face_pull 2x10 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          scapular_retraction 2x10 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m

      DAY Wednesday rest 0m "Full Rest":
        warmup:
          walking 15m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3x10 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
          cat_cow 2x10 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m

      DAY Thursday rest 0m "Full Rest — Travel or Weigh-In Prep":
        warmup:
          walking 15m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3x10 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          spinal_twist 5m

      DAY Friday rest 0m "Weigh-In Day — Minimal Movement":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 2x10 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          hip_flexor_stretch 2x30 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          forward_fold 3m

      DAY Saturday training 0m "COMPETITION DAY":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 1x1 rpe 10 rest 600 seconds
          bench_press 1x1 rpe 10 rest 600 seconds
          deadlift 1x1 rpe 10 rest 600 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m

      DAY Sunday rest 0m "Post-Meet Recovery":
        warmup:
          walking 20m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3x10 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          cat_cow 2x10 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          forward_fold 5m
